releaseState: Local candidate qualified; copy, footer, metadata, robots, feeds, and sitemap repairs are not deployed by this audit.

contentPurpose.evidence: The first viewport identifies the retained product precisely: compare 24 AI development libraries across six adoption axes before committing. It explains why stars are insufficient, names every axis, and gives one clear compare action. Parked generic-directory ambitions are no longer promoted in candidate discovery surfaces.

designQuality.evidence: The restrained analytical UI fits an adoption-decision product, with clear hierarchy, confidence examples, comparison chips, and useful board previews. Exact 390 and 1440 pixel checks show no horizontal overflow; the latest candidate renders both fleet footer elements.

seo.evidence: The candidate passes all 14 critical homepage checks after shortening title and description. Its sitemap was reduced from 948 mixed/parked routes to 37 intentional AI-dev-tool and supporting HTML pages, removing the invalid bare /list URL. The candidate graph has zero internal errors or redirects; contextual /my, submit, random, and RSS routes remain intentionally outside the sitemap.

geo.evidence: Production has all seven machine-readiness primitives and scores A-tier 80. Source discovery is now narrowed from 948 routes, and cataloged feeds, privacy, and terms pages are included. A fresh production-host audit is still required after release to prove route-level Markdown and catalog integrity against the corrected sitemap.

performance.evidence: The optimized production build was re-qualified through a fresh tunnel rather than grading the earlier Next.js development server. PSI Swarm completed 4/4 profiles with a good 2.21 s LCP gate, CLS 0, and at most 27 ms TBT in the slow profile. LCP measured 2.21 s on slow mobile, 4.09 s on a cold mid-mobile run, 545 ms on fast mobile, and 392 ms on desktop. The isolated mid-mobile cold-start variance and approximately 102 KiB unused JavaScript remain P4 advisories.
